extension.summary: Remote-only artwork curator for Kodi video libraries.

extension.news:
v0.33.10 - Menu, notification, cache-report, and AF3 dialog-focus fixes - Adds summary/run-history-audit.txt to diagnostics. - Labels non-active RUNNING rows as STALE HISTORY without updating or deleting database rows. - Performs no schema, database, state, or artwork migration.
v0.33.8 - Verified cache-notification and ReloadSkin correction - Fixes the missing re import that crashed only after Cache Missing Artwork completed. - Reports the real checked, cached, and failed texture-cache counts; zero result segments remain hidden. - Notification rendering is best-effort and cannot turn completed cache work into a failed run. - ReloadSkin is now limited to newly applied direct landscape/thumb artwork on movie and TV-show items; season, episode, set, and nested season artwork do not trigger it.
v0.33.7 - Fail-fast artwork host fallback - Probes one preview URL per remote image host before candidates enter Select Artwork. - Removes candidates from an unreachable image host and continues with the remaining providers. - Shares a five-minute host cooldown across LAC actions to avoid repeated blank previews and timeout queues. - Keeps provider APIs, artwork application, protected collections, database behavior, and manual controls unchanged.
v0.33.5 - Automatic no-change DB write suppression - Captures a late snapshot when Kodi starts its video scan before the LAC service. - Uses only Kodi OnUpdate added=true DBIDs when ScanStarted was missed; generic cache misses remain ignored. - Defers OnRemove cache deletion during scan/clean handoff windows. - Performs one-to-one Clean Library handoff salvage before deleting stale artwork rows. - Keeps fresh-schema-only policy, provider behavior, generated thumbnails, and atomic writes unchanged.
v0.33.3 - Kodi 22 settings-label hotfix - Replaces unsupported literal category and setting labels with localized numeric string IDs. - Adds current resource.language.en_gb and resource.language.id_id catalogs. - Restores all category and setting names in Kodi 22 / Arctic Fuse 3. - Keeps database, DBID handoff, DBID reuse validation, providers, and artwork behavior unchanged.
v0.33.2 - Kodi 22 launch and settings hotfix - Removes a stale import of the deleted legacy maintenance module. - Declares empty string settings as allow-empty for Kodi 22. - Keeps the R7 fresh-schema baseline, active DBID handoff, DBID reuse validation, provider fallback, and atomic writes unchanged.
v0.33.1 - Clean fresh-install baseline - Creates the final artwork database schema directly. - Removes historical schema migration, title-specific repair, collision-repair, and added-event fallback paths. - Startup auto-fill uses exact scan DBID delta only. - Keeps active DBID handoff so the same movie or episode can move from MKV to STRM without artwork scraping. - Keeps normal provider fallback, identity validation, generated local thumbnails, atomic writes, diagnostics, and 58-character family notifications.

extension.summary: Fast automatic and manual Indonesian subtitles with community-first ranking.
Subtitle Indonesia otomatis dan manual dengan pemilihan komunitas.
extension.description: Uses embedded or matching local Indonesian text directly. Every text subtitle path, including automatic, manual, local, embedded, RAW and synchronized profiles, passes through an always-on ad, watermark and fan-credit cleaner while timing, closed captions and styling tags remain intact. The cleaner also removes standalone support-request cues and preserves The Walking Dead proper-name casing as Sanctuary/SANCTUARY. When the MKV or its folder contains a usable matching English text subtitle, Indonesian candidates are synchronized to that exact-video reference. Without embedded text, the add-on downloads top Indonesian subtitles with original timing; F3 or the controller Back/View/Select button cycles them. Online English is never used automatically; it is available only through manual search and can be confirmed with Shift+F3 before synchronizing Indonesian candidates. Image subtitles such as PGS/SUP, VobSub, and DVB are ignored. A visible Settings button exports a sanitized diagnostic ZIP.

Memakai subtitle Indonesia teks embedded atau lokal yang cocok secara langsung. Semua jalur subtitle teks, termasuk otomatis, manual, lokal, embedded, RAW, dan hasil sinkronisasi, selalu melewati pembersih iklan, watermark, dan kredit fan-sub tanpa mengubah timing, closed caption, maupun tag tampilan. Pembersih juga menghapus cue permintaan dukungan yang berdiri sendiri dan mempertahankan kapitalisasi nama Sanctuary/SANCTUARY khusus The Walking Dead. Jika MKV atau foldernya memiliki subtitle Inggris teks yang cocok, kandidat Indonesia disinkronkan ke referensi dari video tersebut. Tanpa referensi teks terpercaya, addon mengunduh kandidat Indonesia teratas dengan timing asli; F3 atau tombol Back/View/Select pada kontroler mengganti hasil RAW. Subtitle Inggris online tidak pernah dipakai otomatis; hanya tersedia melalui pencarian manual. PGS/SUP, VobSub, dan DVB diabaikan. Tombol di Settings mengekspor ZIP diagnostics yang sudah disanitasi.
